name: gradient-magic-ray
title: Magic Ray
blurb: Multi-color gradient transitioning through pink to purple to blue.
description: Linear gradient background flowing diagonal down-right. No animation or interaction.
use_when: Background fill for a page section or hero area.
avoid_when: On text overlays without sufficient contrast — verify readability first.
a11y: Purely visual; no interactive elements. Ensure text overlays have sufficient contrast.
